text:
ingrid: Heads-up: planning a small autoscale tweak for dedicated-gpu-pool-slice-3 to reduce scale-in oscillation. Change is: scale-up threshold 55% -> 65% and scale-down delay +30s. Target rollout tomorrow 02:00 UTC (expected low traffic window).

mike: Who's owning the deploy? Can we canary this first? :eyes:

ingrid: I'll own the rollout. Plan = canary on slice-3-canary (2 nodes) for 15m, run smoke checks, then roll the rest over a staggered 10m window. If canary looks bad -> immediate rollback.

sam: Quick list of smoke checks to run: p95 latency, queue depth, OOM errors, token/sec. Also watch kv-cache-hit ratio and scale event frequency. Keep it short and automated.

yara: Deploy steps + rollback commands pls so oncall can act quickly.
ingrid: Deploy commands (will run in infra-runner with creds):
```
# apply to canary
infractl autoscale update --pool slice-3-canary --scale-up-cpu 65 --scale-down-delay 90 --min 2 --max 4 --reason "reduce-flap-2026-04"
# after 15m and smoke ok, promote to remainder
infractl autoscale promote --from slice-3-canary --to slice-3 --batch-size 2 --stagger 30s
```
Prometheus queries to keep pinned during canary:
```
# p95 generation latency
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[2m])) by (le))
# queue depth
sum(inference_request_queue_length{pool="slice-3-canary"})
# OOMs
sum(inference_worker_ooms_total{pool=~"slice-3.*"})
```

jin: I can schedule and monitor. @deploy-bot can you create the job and post the link? I'll watch Grafana during the window.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout job 789123 for 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z (UTC). Track: https://deploys.internal/release/789123. Notify channel on start/finish.

paul: Rollback commands (if canary fails):
```
# revert to previous settings
infractl autoscale update --pool slice-3 --scale-up-cpu 55 --scale-down-delay 60 --min 1 --max 8 --reason "rollback-789123"
# or abort job
infractl deploy abort --job 789123 --reason "canary-failed"
```

sam: Also add these operational checks before deploy: verify SLOs for other pools, ensure no concurrent maintenance windows, confirm auto-scaler controller health (replicas=3). Pls upload the smoke logs to s3://inference-autoscale/logs/789123 for 48h.

ingrid: PR is open: #4567 (autoscale config + docs). @mike please review. Preflight checklist I'll maintain in the PR.

mike: :eyes: will review within 2h, ping me again if no update.

yara: Smoke script I'll run once canary comes up: `./smoke.sh --pool slice-3-canary --duration 5m --check p95,queue,oom` and post results here.

jin: I'll set temporary alerts for the window: p95 > 250ms -> paging, OOMs > 0 -> high severity. If any alert fires I'll call abort.

sam: One more: ensure autoscaler metrics are being written to long-term store for postmortem (even if short).

ingrid: Great. I'll post final go/no-go at T-24h and T-15m. If anyone absolutely cannot attend the window, flag now. Otherwise proceed with canary at 02:00 UTC. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
